view-01.png.evidence: Sharp tan deck and wake clarify ship; pale aircraft merge at deck overlap.

view-02.png.evidence: Wet reflections, rain, smoke and orange tracer integrate; small troops blend into rubble.

view-03.png.evidence: Quiet deck readable but nearly featureless; wake is a hard rectangular blue strip and world objective overlaps deck.

view-04.png.evidence: Clear broad deck, raised bridge and long soft wake; simple surface shading.

view-05.png.evidence: Sparse flames and faint smoke leave deck readable; dark offset plane shadows show height, while long parallel ocean streaks feel uniform.

view-06.png.evidence: Detailed rooms, wall height, warm/cool light, wood and tile create convincing depth.

view-07.png.evidence: Fainter smoke reveals more aircraft and deck, with distinct orange fire; crowded wings and shadows still obscure player.

view-08.png.evidence: Bright patchwork fields and blotchy grass dominate; flat trees and label overlap undermine coherence.

view-09.png.evidence: Service compound and tracks organize terrain; edged player visible but roofs and ground remain soft.

view-10.png.evidence: Translucent smoke improves central visibility versus dense clumps, but repeated wings, flames and heavy shadows remain busy.

view-11.png.evidence: Broad pale deck is visible through swarm; pale wings and soft dots obscure central player.

view-12.png.evidence: Fog, varied vegetation, muddy ruts and weathered shed build rich depth; tanks blend with terrain.

view-13.png.evidence: Layered sparks and luminous explosion integrate with machinery and atmospheric cliffs; nearby units partly disappear.

view-14.png.evidence: Player and raised buildings read well; apron helps base structure, but abrupt black shoreline strip and uniform streaked water look artificial.

view-15.png.evidence: Clear outlined plane and dark building sides; coarse grass, jagged black coastal edge and plain diagonal water reduce finish.

view-16.png.evidence: Sharp broad deck and wake coherent beneath dense aircraft; player still masked by similar wings.

view-17.png.evidence: Raised bridge/hull and striped deck give form; wake has a repeated scalloped shape and water is long uniform streaks.

view-18.png.evidence: Large flat translucent circles cover planes and deck; rectangular wake and objective text crowd action.

view-19.png.evidence: Broad apron gives hangars context and compound structure; player overlaps roof, coarse grass and black coastal strip reduce polish.

view-20.png.evidence: Runway recognizable but bright tiled fields, blotchy terrain and flat square buildings lack depth; objective covers plane.

view-21.png.evidence: Edged player, varied tree tones and partial compound support hierarchy; fields remain simple patches.

view-22.png.evidence: Crisper wings and white sea flecks add detail but giant flat particle circles obscure the carrier; rectangular wake looks graphic.

view-23.png.evidence: Quiet broad deck contrasts clearly with water; bridge shadow and wake add simple volume.

view-24.png.evidence: Field patchwork is vivid but dominates small player; flat buildings and blotchy grass lack consistent material treatment.

view-25.png.evidence: Aircraft silhouettes clear outside carrier; translucent discs cover deck and hard rectangular wake lacks natural fade.

view-26.png.evidence: Sharp service compound, sheds, tracks and runway provide coherent geography; grass material remains simplified.

view-27.png.evidence: Crisp aircraft and sea flecks help detail; flat circles and rectangular wake remain unconvincing effects over a plain deck.

view-28.png.evidence: Sharp raised ship and restrained flames are readable; smoke is translucent, but uniformly streaked sea and repeated wake scallops remain schematic.

view-29.png.evidence: Quiet ship easily scanned, yet flat tan deck and hard-edged blue wake have weak material and effects craft.

view-30.png.evidence: Sharper fields and water flecks increase detail, but saturated patchwork grass and plain buildings compete with aircraft.

view-31.png.evidence: Broad tan ship contrasts with water and trailing wake; pale aircraft overlap deck.

view-32.png.evidence: Market produce, stone, wood and fabric distinct under consistent shadows; thin paths remain visible.

view-33.png.evidence: Edged player separates from grass; tree variation and compound enrich coast with soft rendering.

view-34.png.evidence: Raised bridge and hull give height; soft deck and strongly parallel ocean streaks lack material variety.

view-35.png.evidence: Base apron and service compound coherent, but soft player blends into roof and abrupt dark coast looks like a seam.

visible_regressions: Long uniform diagonal water streaks in views05/07/10/17/28/34 look less varied and less convincingly watery than cellular waves with small highlights.
Views14/15/19/35 contain abrupt dark shoreline strips that resemble exposed seams rather than naturally integrated coastal structure.
Raised player still overlaps similarly colored hangar roofs in views19/35.
improvements: Views07/10 use more transparent smoke, retaining more carrier and aircraft visibility than earlier opaque granular clusters.
Broad aprons in views19/35 better connect hangars to the surrounding base.
top3_gaps: Preserve player contrast through aircraft, smoke and roof overlaps.
Integrate coastline and water detail without abrupt black strips or a uniform streak texture.
Materials need physical surface response and contact detail rather than added broad texture noise.
_summary.blinding_limitations: All35PNGs viewed. No keys/source/outside files opened. Known unchanged controls retain exact score vectors. Some historical-looking images with rectangular wakes and large disc particles are not identical to previously viewed controls, so are scored on visible differences.
